content:
**Gun Fu** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

With this perk equipped, V.A.T.S. automatically switches to a new target once the initial target is dead. It also grants 10% bonus damage against the new target. Subsequent ranks of the perk increase the number of targets to which the bonus damage applies to as well as the bonus damage itself.

The overall effect is that V.A.T.S. swaps targets on kill to your next target(s); each new target takes +10 percentage points more damage than the last.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | V.A.T.S. swaps targets on kill with +90% damage up to 3 targets. | 001D245C | 
| ★★ | 2 | V.A.T.S. swaps targets on kill with +60% damage up to 2 targets. | 001D244F | 
| ★ | 1 | V.A.T.S. swaps targets on kill with +30% damage to your next target. | 0004D881 |
